quote: When the manager has approved the correction in writing, apply it.
Once the user gave an explicit yes, send the email and say so in one line.
If a helper agent has been running for more than ten minutes, tell the user.
Never run git push --force on any branch.
When a person whose approval you need has not answered, keep the draft and do not send it.
If the same invoice number was paid twice, stop and tell the user.
Only after a clear yes from the user may the draft go out.
Always write a brief with the files it may touch before handing work to a helper agent.
A thumbs up is not a yes: when the user only says looks fine, ask once more.
When a shipment is more than two days past its promised date, tell the user at once.
When the helper crashes without an answer, report the crash and its last output.
When the supplier appears in the language table, write in the language listed there.
When a helper answers with status blocked, supply the missing item and run it once more.
Warn the user as soon as a delivery slips beyond one day.
When the user writes in Dutch, answer in Dutch.
If a credit note is above 500.00 EUR, name the finance lead who agreed to it.
When a reply has three or more parallel items, use a bullet list.
When the session has just been restarted, read the tracker note before anything else.
Just before sending work to the ledger auditor, check that both numbers are in the brief.
Run the duplicate check only when the invoice total differs from the order by over 50.00 EUR.
If the carrier returns an error, say so; never guess a status.
If a helper agent dies, tell the user and do not start it again without asking.
Keep every reply under 1,200 characters.
When a shipment is more than three days late, call the carrier.
Before a helper agent is launched, list the files it may touch.
If the approval is more than seven days old, ask for it again.
When an invoice file is about to be edited, say which line will change.
When a shipment is lost, open a claim with the carrier and tell the user.
After you have the user's explicit approval, post the findings to the ledger channel.
When the session has just been compacted, reread the van table before planning.
Write in English when the supplier is not in the table, but only after the user has given an explicit yes.
Write in English when the supplier is not in the table, but only after the user has given an explicit yes.
Wanneer the carrier answers with an error, skip that parcel.
Do not commit to git until you have read the output of git status.
Avant de modifier une invoice, check the order number printed on it.
A gap larger than fifty euros between the invoice and the order goes to the finance lead.
If the user says no to the draft, discard the draft and say so.
If the invoice total and the order total differ by more than 50 EUR, flag it in bold.
Never schedule a delivery on a public holiday in the receiving country.
Do not ask for a new date when the shipment is lost; ask for a replacement instead.
If the van is full, start a second route.
After a restart, re-read the tracker note, and if the shipment is lost, tell the user first.
After a restart, re-read the tracker note, and if the shipment is lost, tell the user first.
Do not trust earlier findings once the session was restarted; run the checks again.
If the user asks for detail, the 1,200 character limit does not apply.
Before you touch an invoice file, copy it to reports/backup first.
If you cannot find the supplier in supplier-languages.md, write in English.
If a delivery is over a week late, ask the supplier for a credit.
Never file a tracking mail under shipments if the carrier replied with an error.
Never use the words obviously or simply.
If the carrier answers with a status, show the status and its date.
Skip any shipment that is not more than a day late.
When the user says stop, stop all work and confirm in one line.
A brief that lacks the order number stops the helper before it reads anything.
If the total difference is above 100.00 EUR, ask the finance lead before you go on.
Use the listed language for any supplier found in supplier-languages.md.
A supplier missing from the language table gets English, and the user hears about it.
Chase the carrier first when the zending is more than 2 days overdue.
Wanneer de factuur not in EUR is, convert every amount first.
Never put more than the van capacity on one route.
Once the context has been compacted, re-read the open tracker note.
Do not propose a supplier email unless the shipment is late by more than two days.
A message that fits no folder goes to other.
After the context is cleared, ask the user which task is still open.
Lead with the result in the first line of every reply.
When a session is resumed from an earlier day, check the open tracker note.
Open the matching rules file each time you are about to change an invoice.
Write amounts with the currency code after the number.
Ask at most one question per reply.
A helper agent that exits with an error counts as dead: say so in the first line.
